OSEBX.OL.warning: Educational experiment only; not walk-forward validated and ignored by the action layer.

how_to_read.interpretation: Current: ≤1 expected Oslo session behind. Delayed: 2–3. Stale/blocked: >3 or hard failure; no model view.
20/63 days are swing horizons; 126/252 days are long-term. D is downside risk; R is OSEBX outperformance probability.
Identified at ≥60% with a ≥15-point lead. ≥75% is high conviction; otherwise uncertain.
Constructive is favorable trend/risk—not a buy signal. Defensive is elevated risk—not automatically a sell signal.
<70% low; 70–90% moderate; >90% high. Persistence means the label tends to remain, not that price will rise.
Probability of the historical worst drawdown quintile: <25% low; 25–40% elevated; >40% high.
OSEBX outperformance probability: ≥60% favorable; 40–60% mixed; ≤40% unfavorable. Use only when out-of-sample calibrated.
Strong: ≥30 episodes and 5 years. Moderate: 15–29 and ≥3 years. Weak: <15. <5 or inadequate warm-up: unavailable.
Validated secondary evidence may confirm/challenge. Experimental or failed validation must be ignored for suggested actions.

sources: Yahoo Finance adjusted daily closes via yfinance (default market-data feed).

OSEBX.OL is the benchmark for relative outcomes and the only HMM experiment in this version.
